data.one_liner: Geospatial data structures, geometry calculations, geodesy, projections, and vector formats in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Geobase provides data structures and algorithms for geographic and projected coordinates, simple geometries, ellipsoidal and spherical geodesy, tiling schemes, coordinate projections, and vector formats like GeoJSON, WKT, and WKB.
use_when: You need to parse or encode vector formats like GeoJSON, WKT, or WKB in pure Dart.
You need to perform geodesic calculations, spatial measurements, or coordinate transformations without a heavy map UI.
avoid_when: You only need high-level interactive map widgets and UI rendering.
You need built-in live device GPS tracking (use geolocator instead).
strengths: Comprehensive support for geometric calculations, projections, and formats (GeoJSON, WKT, WKB).
Pure Dart package working across mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
weaknesses: Does not include visual map rendering widgets out of the box.
Requires understanding of geospatial terminology and coordinate systems.

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick latlong2 if you need a lightweight library focused primarily on distance and coordinate math for map applications.
